market_outlook.short_term: Markets near records but fragile. AI trade continues to power Nasdaq while financials lag. Oil volatility from Iran rhetoric creates daily swings. Fed's Barkin comments keep rate-cut expectations muted. Crypto momentum strong but extended. Paramount-Warner settlement provides media sector catalyst. Key risk: any geopolitical escalation or inflation surprise could trigger 5-8% correction. History suggests recovery from crashes takes 12-18 months on average.
market_outlook.long_term: Broader earnings growth (UBS Hoffmann) supports structural uptrend. AI capex cycle remains multi-year. Crypto institutionalization is secular. US-China decoupling creates bifurcated supply chains favoring domestic producers. Paramount-Warner and media consolidation reshape content economics. Diesel/energy shortage into 2027 supports energy sector. Midterm election outcome will be pivotal for policy direction. 6-12 month outlook: constructive but volatile, with 10-15% range expected.
